title: Test suite is thin — 4 unit tests, no MCP protocol-layer coverage
evidence: Tests/BrazilianSoccerTests/BrazilianSoccerTests.swift has 4 XCTest methods over the library API; Sources/BrazilianSoccerMCP/main.swift (JSON-RPC dispatch, tool schemas, call routing) has zero tests
suggestion: Add a test that drives tools/list and tools/call through the JSON-RPC layer

title: Standings/stats may double-count overlapping Brasileirão datasets
evidence: Sources/BrazilianSoccer/BrazilianSoccer.swift:66-68 loads both Brasileirao_Matches.csv and novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv as competition 'Brasileirão'; standings() (line 132) and averageGoals() aggregate by competition contains-match, so seasons present in both files are counted twice
suggestion: De-duplicate matches by (date, teams, score) or scope standings to a single source file per competition

title: BR-Football-Dataset competitions retain raw tournament labels
evidence: Sources/BrazilianSoccer/BrazilianSoccer.swift:191 sets competition to r["tournament"] verbatim, so competition filtering by 'Brasileirão' won't match this file's rows
suggestion: Normalize tournament names to the canonical competition set where possible
